proposal.perimeter: The kept rows cover electricity (markt=Elektriciteit) off-take (richting=Afname) consumption for the municipality of Ghent (gemeente=GENT) for the calendar year 2024, broken down by statistical sector, NACE sector and NACE subsector. They exclude gas consumption, exclude injected (fed-back) electricity, and exclude the 'Gecombineerd' direction rows. The municipality assignment is based on the postal code of the delivery address, not necessarily the legal municipal boundary.
proposal.openQuestion: The documentation does not state the measurement unit of the 'afname' column (labelled only as a 'double' with a description of an approximated consumption volume); converting the summed value to GWh requires assuming it is expressed in kWh, which is the Fluvius convention but is not explicitly declared here, and that assumption is left unconfirmed.
